title: ReminderAlarmReceiver reads and forwards the new extras
name: onReceive
description: Reads the profileId/medicationId/defaultDoseAmount extras ExactAlarmScheduler now attaches, and passes them through to NotificationHelper.sendReminder's extended signature (task-011) so it can build the notification's 'log dose' action.
acceptance_criteria: Calls NotificationHelper.sendReminder(context, doseLogId, title, text, profileId, medicationId, defaultDoseAmount)
The existing doseLogId/title/text extraction and early returns are unchanged
exact_code:
override fun onReceive(context: Context, intent: Intent) {
        val doseLogId = intent.getIntExtra(ExactAlarmScheduler.EXTRA_DOSE_LOG_ID, -1)
        if (doseLogId == -1) return
        val title = intent.getStringExtra(ExactAlarmScheduler.EXTRA_TITLE) ?: return
        val text = intent.getStringExtra(ExactAlarmScheduler.EXTRA_TEXT) ?: return
        val profileId = intent.getIntExtra(ExactAlarmScheduler.EXTRA_PROFILE_ID, -1)
        val medicationId = intent.getIntExtra(ExactAlarmScheduler.EXTRA_MEDICATION_ID, -1)
        val defaultDoseAmount = intent.getStringExtra(ExactAlarmScheduler.EXTRA_DEFAULT_DOSE_AMOUNT) ?: ""
        NotificationHelper.sendReminder(context, doseLogId, title, text, profileId, medicationId, defaultDoseAmount)
    }
